subject: Eval access sprint owners & success gates — next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Eval access sprint owners & success gates — next steps

Hi Priya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment heading into the trial sprint.

Key outcomes from the call:
- Success criteria: (1) Ingest sample clinical dataset (de-identified) and return redact-and-summarize accuracy >= 95% on spot-checks; (2) 95th percentile generation latency < 450ms for 512-token budgets; (3) embedding similarity pipeline matches existing infra for retrieval recall baseline.
- Timeline: Week 0 (this week) — access & SSO setup; Week 1 — smoke tests + sample prompts; Weeks 2–3 — feature evaluation and quality checks; Week 4 — wrap + exec review.
- Ownership: Lumos: Anil (infra), Sara (data lead); Redwood: Marissa (CS lead), Jonas (AE), Ben (trial coordinator).

What we need from Lumos to start access provisioning:
1) List of users (name + email + role) to invite to SSO and their desired role (admin/tester).
2) SAML metadata or SSO contact for SSO/SAML exchange. If SSO is not ready, confirm emails for SSO invites and we can provision temporary API keys for smoke tests.
3) IP ranges for allowlist (if you require network restrictions).

Action items I propose (happy to change):
- Priya: confirm owners list + SSO metadata or confirmation you want temp API keys (due Mon 11/23).
- Marissa/Ben: coordinate trial dashboard and success gating for Week 4 exec review.
- Dev/Infra: provisioning once Priya confirms SSO vs API key.

Attachment: redwood-eval-playbook.pdf (high-level runbook + example prompts).

If that matches, I’ll send the SSO/SP metadata from our side and kick off provisioning with Dev.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumoshealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Anil Kapoor <anil.kapoor@lumoshealth.com>, Sara Mills <sara.mills@lumoshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval access sprint owners & success gates — next steps

Jonas — thanks for the clear summary. We’re aligned and can proceed with the following constraints from Lumos security and infra: 

Confirmed POC owners (for SSO invites / audit):
- Anil Kapoor (anil.kapoor@lumoshealth.com) — Infra lead (primary SSO admin)
- Sara Mills (sara.mills@lumoshealth.com) — Data lead (will validate datasets)
- Priya Desai (priya.desai@lumoshealth.com) — Product sponsor / exec reviewer

Security constraints and asks:
- We require SAML SSO (IdP metadata attached). Please provide your SP metadata and the SSO setup checklist.
- IP allowlist: our egress ranges are 34.201.0.0/16 and 34.202.128.0/18 for the test subnet — please add to your allowlist for the trial.
- Audit/logging: we need request logs retained for 90 days for the trial, and token-based API keys must be short-lived. For initial smoke tests we can accept a time-limited API key (7 day expiry) if SSO will take longer than 48 hours.

Attachment: lumos-sso-metadata.xml

We’d like to get the smoke test access by Wed 11/25 if possible. Let me know if you need anything else.

—Priya
Priya Desai
Sr. Product Manager, Lumos Health
priay.desai@lumoshealth.com | (617) 555-0199

Folks — forwarding Lumos’ reply and SSO metadata. Priya asked for smoke-test access by Wed 11/25 and would accept a 7-day temporary API key if SP setup takes longer. Lumos gave their required IP ranges (34.201.0.0/16, 34.202.128.0/18) and wants 90-day log retention for the trial.

Action items (owner / eta):
- Dev: prepare SP metadata (SAML) and SSO checklist; create a temporary API key with scope: "ingest,generate,embeddings" and expiry 7 days; add IP allowlist entries; confirm log retention can be set to 90 days for this trial. Target: Wed 11/25 EOD (earlier if possible).
- Marissa: get the trial dashboard ready and populate the success gating checklist (I’ll share the sheet).
- Ben: coordinate with Priya on a 30-minute smoke-test window once access is available.

Quoted for context below.

Next steps:
